title: white canvas single colour when labelled
rule: White canvas; single colour when bars are already labelled. `#FFFFFF`. Multi-colour only for multiple series or a highlight. Approved NSW / Aboriginal chart-mark palettes only (pre-validated on white). Start with theme 01 then 02.
pass_when: Chart sits on white; labelled single-series bars use one colour; extra colours only for series or highlight; NSW/Aboriginal palettes only.
fail_when: Non-white canvas; rainbow single-series labelled bars; unapproved palette.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Established conventions (next row) as a free-for-all palette.
